mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 68 degrees at Fireman's Park, and we have a Waning Gibbous moon tonight. The overnight low will drop to 52 degrees with no rain in the forecast. If you look toward Mount Horeb at 8:38 PM, you might spot the International Space Station crossing the sky toward Belleville for three minutes.

The Plan Commission has several development projects on the agenda for October 5, including new survey maps for Country View Court and site plans for the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the city is continuing its community outreach with initiatives like the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan and various park improvements.

There is plenty to do in town. We have Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, with more trivia and live music at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory continuing through the rest of the week.

In a noteworthy call from September 15, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on US Highways 18 and 151. Thankfully, there were no injuries reported, and one driver was cited for unsafe lane deviation.
It is a great time to enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. Culver's is open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by soon to grab a scoop.
